verdicts.reason: A uses the tall format well, with a large headline, a clear CTA and evenly spaced pills. But the pill order is reversed from the original (Honey Rosemary first), the pills have uneven widths, the headline nearly touches the right edge, and the gap between headline and body is too large. B crams everything into the top two-thirds and leaves a large dead area at the bottom. Its left edges are ragged: the headline is indented about 27px while the body and the Honey Rosemary pill sit at 10px, and the pills are staggered. Its decorative circles crowd the brand mark and headline.
